meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍热门平台，掌握短篇网文爆款题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速知道最近什么题材受欢迎
copy.tagline_en: Scan top platforms to spot viral short-story topics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short fiction and need to know what's trending.

howto.what: Claude 会变成短篇网文市场分析师：扫过平台榜单后产出一份扫榜报告，含情绪热度排行、题材热点、风口预警、值得写的方向，并做选题匹配。
howto.when: 输入 /story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜 等命令，或提到「短篇什么火」等话题时触发；它会先问你想看哪个平台、有没有想写的方向。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言的短篇榜单
say.note: 会先问平台和方向，再采集分析

say.text: 七猫和点众的短篇，哪个更适合写虐恋？
这是我截的黑岩榜单，帮我出份扫榜报告
say.note: 会用你提供的数据做分析

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into a short-story web-fiction market analyst. It scans platform charts and produces a report with emotion rankings, hot genres, trend warnings, write-worthy directions and topic matching.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /story-short-scan, /短篇扫榜, or when you ask what short stories are trending or about Zhihu story rankings. It first asks which platform and direction you want.

say_en.text: Scan the Zhihu Yanyan short-story charts for me
say_en.note: It asks platform and focus first

say_en.text: Qimao or Dianzhong: which fits a sad-romance short?
Here's my Heiyan chart screenshot, write a scan report
